children: U.S. rare disease drugmaker's fiscal Q4 net loss narrowed from prior year
R&D expenses for fiscal Q4 declined, mainly due to lower manufacturing costs for ersodetug
General and administrative expenses rose, driven by higher stock-based compensation and professional fees
Rezolute expects topline results from the upLIFT Phase 3 tumor HI study before end-2026
Company awaits FDA feedback on the sunRIZE study for congenital HI
LOWER MANUFACTURING COSTS - Co said decrease in R&D expenses was primarily due to lower manufacturing costs for ersodetug
HIGHER STOCK COMPENSATION AND FEES - Co attributed rise in G&A expenses to increased employee-related stock-based compensation and professional fees for future ersodetug commercial activities
